properties.notes: Site is allocated as a Town Centre Key Opportunity Site for residential and/or town centre uses in Local Plan Policies EC6 (Development Sites within the Town Centre Boundary) and H2 (Key Housing Sites). Policies TC3 and H2 of the Regulation 19 consultation draft Local Plan Review document propose the retention of this allocation. Site previously had outline consent for a 312-unit residential scheme, but this has now expired (CR/2007/0114/OUT). Minimum figure of 99 is based on the figure given in the Local Plan Housing Trajectory. Maximum figure of 300 is informed by dwelling total of 312 from lapsed outline consent CR/2007/0114/OUT.
